network.hostNotFound: The host {{host}} could not be found. Check the address for typos and that this computer is online.
network.untrustedAuthority: The server's certificate is not signed by an authority this computer trusts. {{advice}}
network.handshakeCertificate: The server ended the TLS handshake. Check that it accepts the client certificate set for this host.
network.handshake: The server ended the TLS handshake. {{advice}}
network.hostMismatch: The server's certificate is not valid for {{host}}. Check that the address is the one the certificate was issued for.
network.certificateExpired: The server's certificate has expired or is not valid yet. Check the clock on this computer, or renew the certificate.
network.proxyConnect: Could not connect to the proxy server. Check the proxy address in {{source}}.
network.proxyConnectSettings: Could not connect to the proxy server. Check the proxy address in the network settings.
network.dial: Could not connect to {{host}}. Check that the server is running and that the host and port are right.
network.dialServer: Could not connect to the server. Check that the server is running and that the host and port are right.

advice.untrustedAuthority: Trust its certificate authority, or turn off certificate verification for this request.
advice.clientCertificate: If the server requires a client certificate, add one for this host in the desktop app's network settings.

blocked.address: private and local addresses are blocked
blocked.addressResolved: private and local addresses are blocked: {{host}} resolves to {{address}}
blocked.host: this host is not on the list of hosts that may be called
blocked.hostNamed: this host is not on the list of hosts that may be called: {{host}}

request.urlRequired: enter a URL to send the request to
request.urlScheme: unsupported URL scheme "{{scheme}}", use http or https
request.urlInvalidMissing: "{{url}}" is not a valid URL because {{reason}}
request.variablesInvalid: environment variables are not valid JSON: {{detail}}
request.bodyTooLarge: request body is larger than 10 MB
request.tooLargeExpanded: the request is larger than 10 MB once variables are filled in
request.variablesTooDeep: the variables refer to each other too many times to fill in; simplify the variables that contain {{example}}
request.trailingJson: unexpected text after the JSON value
request.expectedRows: expected a JSON object or a list of rows

files.unavailable: {{example}} reads files only in the desktop app, or in gostman run, send and load with --allow-files
files.relativePath: open a workspace folder to use a relative path in {{example}}, or give an absolute path
files.httpOnly: {{example}} reads files only in HTTP and GraphQL requests
files.outsideFolder: "{{path}}" is outside the collection folder; a collection reads only files inside its folder
files.isFolder: "{{path}}" is a folder, not a file
files.pathMissing: {{example}} needs a file path between the parentheses
files.networkPath: "{{path}}" is a network or device path. Files are read only from this computer's drives, so your Windows sign-in is never sent to another computer. Copy the file to this computer or map the share to a drive letter

attachments.unavailable: files attached from disk are sent only by the desktop app
attachments.tooLarge: the attached files are larger than {{size}} GB together
attachments.signed: this authentication signs the whole body, so attached files are limited to {{size}} MB together with it

proxy.invalidAddress: "{{address}}" is not a valid proxy address
proxy.unsupportedScheme: unsupported proxy scheme "{{scheme}}", use http, https or socks5
